newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed's Augustine to retire as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed's Augustine to retire as CEO.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp. said Friday that Norman Augustine will retire as chief executive later this year but remain chairman of the board.
The Bethesda, Md.-based defence company said Augustine's retirement was "in keeping with his longstanding plans" and further details of the succession plan will be released later Friday.
The Wall Street Journal, citing people familiar with the matter, reported Friday that Augustine, 61, will be succeeded by Vance Coffman, Lockheed's president.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Lockheed's stock fell 12.5 cents to $83.75 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
